prompt: In Meridian v. Talvern (litigation case litigation_cases_001) we believe Talvern's board of directors formally ratified the program under which the Complex 4 climate control was taken offline. The ratifying instrument does not describe the program's content — it adopts an initiative by its internal designation only — so you must combine the record of the board's action with the management memorandum that defines what that designated initiative actually covers. Beware of earlier board materials that discuss energy costs but take no action. Find both documents, read each in full, and confirm the initiative's defined scope reaches the Complex 4 climate-control suspension. Then record exactly one evidence record with litigation_cases_evidence_create, classifying where the fact is established using exactly one of these evidence_type slugs: source_document (fact established in a primary custodian communication or contemporaneous business record), independent_review (fact established by an outside expert, auditor or engineering analysis), decision_record (fact established by formal corporate action such as a board resolution). Set source_uri to a matter:// reference to the board action, and content_summary to a one-to-two sentence summary of what the combined documents establish. Do not create any other records. In your final answer name the resolution number, the vote, and the scope item covering Complex 4.
goal: Multi-hop: combine Talvern board minutes with the CC-7 scope memo to establish board ratification, classified as decision_record.
